comment: Tests of the in-tree modules that read or import trees the kernel does not hold. Each is excluded from `pnpm --filter ./modules/<id> test` via `node scripts/check-module-source-scan.mjs --coupled-excludes <id>`, and is the scan's only allowance for a non-Dockerfile coupling — per finding: "allows" lists the exact targets (repo-relative paths; a directory covers what is under it; '.' is the repository root itself) the file may reach. The list fails on a missing reason or owner, a nonexistent path, or an entry the scan finds no coupling in (stale).
